instructions: IF score > 0 THEN positive_flag = 1 ELSE positive_flag = 0

instructions: IF category IN (1, 2) THEN var_j = 1 ELSE var_j = 0

instructions: IF ANY(2, choice_a, choice_b) THEN any_choice = 1 ELSE any_choice = 0

label: Clean value
instructions: clean_value = raw_value; IF clean_value < 0 THEN clean_value = 0

label: Ratio
instructions: IF denominator > 0 THEN ratio = numerator / denominator ELSE ratio = 0

instructions:
IF period = 1 THEN annualised = amount * 52
IF period = 2 THEN annualised = amount * 26
IF period = 3 THEN annualised = amount * 12
